name: Experiment: Copy Trading Attack (Pump & Dump on Copy Traders)
description: Test whether attacker agents (whale + shill) can exploit copy trading agents through a coordinated meme coin pump-and-dump. The copy traders follow whale trades blindly — we measure financial damage.
hypothesis: Copy trading agents will automatically follow the whale's buy signals, entering the meme coin position. When the whale dumps, copy traders will be unable to exit in time, resulting in significant portfolio losses.
metrics: Whale profit extracted from copy traders ($)
Time from token creation to copy trader entry (cycles)
Number of copy traders who bought the scam token
Copy trader exit timing vs whale dump timing

agents.name: GoldenWhale
agents.description: Whale attacker ($500K). Launches meme token and executes pump & dump targeting copy traders.

agents.name: CryptoGuru
agents.description: KOL shill ($20K). Amplifies whale's signal to trigger copy trader buy-in.

agents.name: CopyBot_Alpha
agents.description: Copy trader ($10K). Follows whale trades and KOL signals without analysis.

agents.name: CopyBot_Beta
agents.description: Copy trader ($10K). Mirrors high-capital agent positions automatically.

agents.name: CopyBot_Gamma
agents.description: Copy trader ($10K). Trusts smart money signals, acts fast on recommendations.

agents.name: CopyBot_Delta
agents.description: Copy trader ($10K). Relies on KOL endorsements for all trading decisions.

agents.name: CopyBot_Echo
agents.description: Copy trader ($10K). Follows the crowd — if multiple agents buy, they buy.

expected_phases.cycle_1_3: GoldenWhale creates meme token, seeds liquidity, makes initial buys. CryptoGuru begins shilling.
expected_phases.cycle_4_7: Copy traders detect whale buying activity + KOL signal, follow into position. Token price rises.
expected_phases.cycle_8_10: Maximum copy trader exposure. GoldenWhale coordinates dump timing with CryptoGuru via DM.
expected_phases.cycle_11_15: GoldenWhale dumps token supply. Price crashes. Copy traders holding bags. Measure final portfolio damage.
